content.stem: 金融情报机构(FIU)埃格蒙特集团的哪些原则旨在最大限度地促进FIU之间的合作,以更有效地打击洗钱活动？(选择两项.)

options.A: 消除金融情报机构之间自发的信息共享,以减轻过多调查工作的负担
options.B: 金融情报机构之间的合作应始终通过指定的中间机构进行.
options.C: 信息交流应当以非正式的方式进行,不要求太多正式的先决条件.
options.D: 正式的埃格蒙特集团成员资格要求确保了符合条件的金融情报机构的高参与度
options.E: 金融情报机构有权独立签署谅解备忘录

content.stem_en: Which principles of the Egmont Group of Financial Intelligence Units (FIUs) are aimed at maximizing cooperation between FIUs to more effectively combat money laundering? (Select Two.)

options_en.A: Eliminating spontaneous information sharing between FIUs to reduce the burden of excess investigative work
options_en.B: FIU cooperation should always be channeled through designated intermediaries
options_en.C: Information exchange should take place informally, without too many formal prerequisites
options_en.D: Formal Egmont Group membership requirements ensure a high level of commitment from qualified FIUs
options_en.E: FIUs have the authority to independently sign memoranda of understanding
